primary_question: How did model and backend variance interact with stack coherence across frozen runtime runs?

selection_policy.fallback_trigger: inventory failure, HTTP failure, empty assistant content, or failed readiness probe
selection_policy.latency_policy: one launch-time readiness probe per candidate; no mid-run switching

qualified_primary.interpretation: qualified primary with bounded residual model variance

current_demo.qualification_scope: preflight plus one smoke turn only
current_demo.interpretation: operational fallback, not a replacement qualification

interpretive_guard: Pass and failure counts separate deterministic contract evidence from model-generated route, selection, and plan variance. No model is promoted to qualified replacement without the same frozen runtime campaign.
